CommunityApplications.Profile:
Self-hosted apps by bdlnaredi.
MediaHub: one dashboard for Sonarr, Radarr, qBittorrent, Seerr, Plex and Unraid, with requests, library tools, alerts and health checks.
Bahi: your TallyPrime accounting books on your phone. A small agent on the Tally PC syncs ledgers, vouchers, stock, bill-wise dues and GST to your Unraid server, with Tally-style invoice and ledger PDFs.
For help or bug reports, open an issue on each app's GitHub page.
